card.title: You Could at Least…
card.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my wet sock beside your dinner. From your puddle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you won't mind it sharing the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An apology would dry the atmosphere considerably.

mechanism: A displays a wet sock as a continuing inconvenience and makes apology the route to removing it.
confusable: Unlike simply asking for remorse, A must make the physical nuisance visible and difficult to ignore.
comparison: D27-a places the grievance on the dinner table; D27-b lays out a timetable and receipt reconstructing a disrupted evening.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
